column1: # Shop screens (C5 tilemap scripts: `40 pos16 w h tile16` = a w x 2 block of tiles, top row tile.., bottom tile+$10;
# glyph set 01D2B7 = 32 cells, cell k<16 -> tile C0+k, k>=16 -> E0+k-16; English cells in script/grid_specs.tsv).

column4: weapon shop nameplate 武器屋の主人 -> "Smith" (cells 10-15)
item shop nameplate 道具屋の娘 -> "Clerk" (cells 16-20)
weapon shop header 武器屋 -> "Arms" (cells 0-2, cols 8-10 as in JP, so "Arms 1" stays centred; the digit is at col 11)
item shop header 道具屋 -> "Item" (cells 6-8, cols 8-10 as in JP: only a 3-cell label centres against the fixed digit, docs/inkbox.tsv; "Items" was 4 cells, 6 px off)
prompts 誰が買う？ 誰が売る？ 誰と話の？ (5x2 maps, op 18 at C5:B2F0..) -> "Who?" (cells 21-25)
status gender value (C1:8AA8 `LDA #$02A4 女 / LDA #$02F7 男`, then JSL C1:8EB9 one glyph) -> ♀ 004A / ♂ 0049
